items.text:
V Super Soda expands its lineup with V Orange, a new 300ml drink made with 100% natural flavors and no caffeine. Each can contains 96 calories and is enriched with Vitamin D, offering a fresh new addition to the brand’s range.

أطلقت V Super Soda مشروبها الجديد V Orange بحجم 300 مل، بنكهات طبيعية 100% وبدون كافيين. ويحتوي كل عبوة على 96 سعرة حرارية، بالإضافة إلى فيتامين D، ليقدّم خيارًا جديدًا ضمن مجموعة مشروبات العلامة التجارية.

"Why is it only $149?"

Because we deleted the calls, briefs, project managers, and status meetings. A code-driven motion pipeline does the work; a human checks every frame. You pay for output, not overhead.

https://ads.virtualoranges.com

October is Agent Orange Awareness Month
Agent Orange was a tactical herbicide used by the U.S. military during the Vietnam War to clear trees and vegetation. It contained trace amounts of TCDD, a highly toxic form of dioxin.

For many veterans, the effects of possible exposure have been a long-term concern. The VA recognizes certain cancers and other health conditions—including type 2 diabetes, ischemic heart disease, Parkinsonism, hypertension, and hypothyroidism—as potentially related to qualifying service and herbicide exposure.

If you served in Vietnam or another qualifying location, or had a military role involving herbicides, you may want to ask about your health and benefits options. Eligibility depends on your service and circumstances.

San Diego resources:

• Agent Orange Registry evaluation at VA San Diego: 858-642-3995

• San Diego County Office of Military & Veterans Affairs: 1-866-726-8831 — benefits counseling and help with claims

• VA Agent Orange information: https://www.va.gov/disability/eligibility/hazardous-materials-exposure/agent-orange/

The VA Registry exam is free for eligible veterans. It is a health evaluation, not a disability compensation exam, and veterans who want compensation must file a separate claim.

VFW Post 3787 honors the veterans living with the effects of toxic exposure. We encourage veterans and families to seek trusted information and support.
